Readers usually want a clear answer
Companion Animal Travel Desk

Traveling with pets on Aurelia Skyways

This guide helps you plan a smoother trip when a companion animal is flying with you. Our goal is to keep the process steady, clear, and calm from the first check-in step to the handoff at arrival.

The first thing we do is review the animal's comfort needs and make sure the travel setup matches the trip. The desk team records any service changes in the ledger so the crew has the same information at every handoff. That keeps the plan simple for everyone involved and helps avoid rushed last-minute fixes.

If a concern comes up during review, the case moves through a calm stepwise check so the right person sees it without confusion. <<FACT F106>> This keeps the transfer path orderly and helps the next team know what to do next. Travelers should keep their travel details easy to reach and follow the packing guidance given by the desk.

For any onboard issue or incident, the desk uses a standard report path so nothing gets missed. <<FACT F090>> After that, the file stays with the service team for follow-up and review. If you are traveling with a pet like Harley, it is best to keep the carrier clean, secure, and comfortable before departure.

Crate fit matters too, especially for cats, since the carrier must leave enough space for safe positioning and gentle movement. <<FACT F067>> The team may also check that the crate closes properly and that the animal can stay settled throughout the trip. Small adjustments made early usually prevent bigger problems later.

If you are unsure about any step, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can walk you through the process and coordinate the next action with the rest of the service team.
